comparison.objective: Push a spacer through a covered channel, recover it, and return the pusher; candidate seats a collet in an eccentric nut ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Indirect linear pushing and subsequent pick/place versus marked groove alignment and changing-axis snap insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Measured channel exit, nest placement, tool return, and clearance versus continuous ring retention and nondestructive withdrawal resistance.
comparison.reason: Shared contact control is generic; the tested mechanisms and terminal states differ. Candidate snap-force threshold is unspecified.
